description: Source code for channel-related API handlers in Mattermost, including creating, updating, moving, restoring, and deleting channels, as well as managing channel members.

methods.name: InitChannelLocal
methods.description: Initializes API routes for channel operations such as create, delete, move, update privacy, restore, and member management.

methods.name: localCreateChannel
methods.description: Handles creation of a new channel based on JSON request body.

methods.name: localUpdateChannelPrivacy
methods.description: Updates the privacy setting of a specified channel.

methods.name: localAddChannelMember
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel, with optional post root ID validation.

methods.name: localRemoveChannelMember
methods.description: Removes a user from a channel.

methods.name: localPatchChannel
methods.description: Applies a patch to update channel properties.

methods.name: localMoveChannel
methods.description: Moves a channel to a different team.

methods.name: localDeleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a channel, either soft or permanent.
